_comment: 40mcp MCP-linking config. Points at two public upstream MCP servers: Microsoft Learn Docs and HuggingFace. Use with: 40mcp link configs/microsoft-huggingface-bridge.mcp.json

msdocs._note: Remote HTTP/SSE MCP server. Exposes microsoft_docs_search, microsoft_code_sample_search, microsoft_docs_fetch.

hf._note: Remote HTTP MCP server. Exposes model / dataset / space search, paper search, and gr_* inference tools. Public read-only access works without a token.
